name: The Her
source: Waking up on the streets can be a cruel fate. But when Casey meets Ethan, a wealthy philanthropist, their luck seems to change. With Ethan’s offer to help Casey attend college, a new hope emerges. As Casey settles into Ethan’s grand home, they face an unexpected challenge: navigating a wardrobe that doesn’t quite fit their own style. With only Ethan’s sister’s clothes available, Casey must find a way to make do.
translation: 流落街头醒来的滋味残酷无比；然而当凯西遇到富有的慈善家伊森后，命运似乎迎来了转机。伊森主动提出资助凯西攻读大学，为凯西重新点燃了人生的希望。可当凯西住进伊森气派的豪宅后，却面临着一个意想不到的难题：衣柜里的衣服与自己平时的穿衣风格实在格格不入——由于屋里只有伊森妹妹留下的女装可穿，凯西只好设法将就应付。
